script.vo01: There's an agent to guide manufacturers through these processes. It pulls data from The ERP and Line telemetry, engages you directly in Microsoft Teams.
script.vo02: Before, they would have needed to jump across multiple systems to manually gather insights, and automatically highlight what needs attention first.
script.vo03: It reads the ERP, Line telemetry, Effectiveness tracking. It engages you in Microsoft Teams and Outlook. And it can monitor supplier risk across quality, delivery, financial, showing the reasoning behind every answer.
script.vo04: Let's say a manager needs to monitor supplier risk across quality, delivery, financial. But what if the manager wants to go a step further? The agent handles the analysis and offers a set of targeted recommendations right in their workflow. Work like this used to require cross-referencing different systems by hand.
script.vo05: Now, with unified data context across The ERP and Line telemetry, the agent can rapidly generate a phased plan with quick wins. For risk mitigation, the agent helps as well, outlining a strategy that keeps the work on track. When the detail is needed, they simply ask, and the agent quickly compiles a clear summary.
script.vo06: It can go further in the same conversation, without anyone switching tools. Finally, the agent creates a monitoring plan, so teams keep the effort aligned to the metrics they are measured on.
script.vo_payoff: With Supplier Risk Monitoring Agent, manufacturers get guided assistance embedded directly into their workflows.
script.vo_helps: The result? Work that moves faster, stays consistent, and holds the same standard every time it runs.
script.vo_cta: Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
